item: Branch to Verkhnyaya Salda and Nizhnyaya Salda
source_quote: отремонтированный 18-километровый участок газопровода-отвода к городам Верхняя и Нижняя Салда (search snippet, unverified)
notes: Interfax press release 'Gazprom transgaz Ekaterinburg zavershil remont gazoprovoda k gorodam Verhnyaya i Nizhnyaya Salda' (search snippet) says a repaired 18 km SECTION was reconnected; that is a repair section, not full branch length (OSM 68 km), and the page is bot-walled (verifier 200 but no text), so not a validated ref. Possible lead for a later pass via Wayback.

No length found. A Russian gov decree (816-r) snippet mentions a 700 mm branch to Sukhoi Log, Bogdanovich, Asbest, Rezh (no km seen, not opened) - suggests Sukhoi Log/Asbest-1 may be parts of one branch system; check before staging separately.
Gazprom transgaz press: branch to Asbest also feeds Rezh; no length found; probably one branch system with Sukhoi Log/Bogdanovich (700 mm per decree snippet vs OSM 530 mm).

Likely the Sverdlovsk-area end of P2297 Dolgoderevenskoye-Sysert (roster 127 km, 1020 mm, operating). A Gazprom-related snippet states the 127 km Dolgoderevenskoye-Sysert pipeline 1000 mm; OSM 55 km is probably a fragment/tail. Not confirmed; no separate Sverdlovsk-Sysert length found.
